title: Idempotency, concurrency, retry/recovery and transaction integrity

steps.title: Documents + Versions Integrity
steps.description: Document and version tables present for multi-table commits
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='doc' AND c.relname IN ('documents','document_versions')

steps.title: Lifecycle History Append Model
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='stu' AND c.relname='lifecycle_history' AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity

steps.title: Unauth Mutation Path Blocked
steps.description: Unauthenticated writes cannot bypass integrity controls
